Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

ToolLLM: Facilitating Large Language Models to Master 16000+ Real-world APIs (2307.16789v1) · paper method: ToolEval measures pass rate through completion and exclusion rules and win rate through ChatGPT path comparisons; its judge-validation study uses four human preference annotations for each of 600 solution pairs.

ToolLLM: Facilitating Large Language Models to Master 16000+ Real-world APIs (2307.16789v1) · paper method: For API responses exceeding 2,048 tokens, ToolBench applies a ChatGPT-derived compression schema and, if necessary, retains only the first 2,048 tokens.
